messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P1: Usage ingestion pipeline - intermittent token count underreporting for hosted models (rule: metering.token_delta > 5% for > 5m)
incident-bot: Alert details: suspect shard: ingest-aggregator-7, start: 2026-03-14T09:20:05Z, samples: abnormal drop in token_count in last 6m
alice (oncall-sre): @channel getting PagerDuty, I'm taking it. Paging now.
alice (oncall-sre): acked the PD incident, assigning to eng-infra + billing for impact analysis :white_check_mark:
carol (eng-infra): on it. first quick check: aggregator metrics show a 10-40% drop for keys routed to ingest-aggregator-7. root cause unknown.
carol (eng-infra): pulling logs: `kubectl logs -n metering ingest-aggregator-7 --since=15m | grep token_count`
carol (eng-infra): found repeated WARNs: `KV cache miss exceeded threshold, dropping partial batches` around 09:18:xx.
dave (eng-ml): could be a quantized model variant mismatch? but this is the ingestion side before serving, hmm. any recent deploys?
alice (oncall-sre): deploy history: last aggregator deploy 2 days ago. no hotfixes in last hour.
bob (billing): what's the customer impact? Are invoices affected yet? we have invoicing run scheduled tonight at 23:00 UTC.
carol (eng-infra): preliminary: total token count delta across last hour ~ -18% for some tenants; system-level aggregated totals still within 2% because fallback pipeline does sampling. but per-account counts for high-volume customers show undercount.
eve (customer-success): if invoices are undercounted, customers will see lower usage this cycle. downstream: they report lower charges, then spike next month — we need to decide whether to hold invoicing until backfill completes.
alice (oncall-sre): marking customer-impact potential: partial undercount for a subset of customers. severity -> escalate to P0 billing risk if we cannot remediate before invoicing.
incident-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-token-delta
frank (oncall-sre-2): I'm standing by to take handoff in 40m if needed. what mitigations can we do quick?
carol (eng-infra): quick mitigations: 1) restart ingest-aggregator-7 pod 2) enable synchronous forwarder to aggregator-3/4 for the affected shard 3) trigger immediate backfill job for last 6 hours.
dave (eng-ml): restart looks safe. backfill could be heavy but we can throttle. if we route traffic off of 7 to healthy aggregators, we should get immediate improvement.
alice (oncall-sre): doing rolling restart on ingest-aggregator-7 now.
alice (oncall-sre): `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ingest-aggregator -n metering --field-selector spec.nodeName=ingest-aggregator-7`
incident-bot: deployment rollout started (09:27:12 UTC). health checks running.
carol (eng-infra): after restart: metrics show immediate partial recovery to -5% delta. but still some residual missing batches. suspect a batching/timer edge-case.
dave (eng-ml): can you paste the sample log where kv-cache miss occurs?
carol (eng-infra): ```
Suspicious log excerpt:
[2026-03-14T09:18:23Z] WARN  ingest-aggregator-7 batch_processor - kv_cache_miss_count=312 drop=8 partial=true
[2026-03-14T09:18:24Z] WARN  ingest-aggregator-7 batch_processor - batching_timer_expired=true flush_count=0
```
carol (eng-infra): looks like a race where batching timer triggers but KV cache eviction is concurrent.
dave (eng-ml): that aligns with a change we merged to timer handling in PR #4332 (deployed 48h ago). it's probably exposing a rare race.
alice (oncall-sre): can we patch quickly? or do we run a mitigative config?
carol (eng-infra): safe mitigation: increase batching_timer_ms from 20->50 for aggregator-7 and split load to aggregator-3/4. will reduce latency slightly but close the race.
bob (billing): timeline for backfill? if we can backfill before 23:00 UTC, we can proceed with invoicing as planned. otherwise, we need approval to pause invoices and notify customers.
dave (eng-ml): I can prepare a minimal fix to timer handling but that requires a deploy across aggregators, riskier. prefer config change + backfill.
alice (oncall-sre): applying config change to shard 7 and rebalancer to shift 25% traffic to aggregator-3/4.
alice (oncall-sre): `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: ingest-aggregator-config-7
data:
  batching_timer_ms: "50"
  kv_cache_eviction_ms: "60000"
EOF`
incident-bot: config applied (09:42:01 UTC). rebalancer enacting shift.
carol (eng-infra): downstream ingestion metrics: token delta now at -1.8% across affected accounts. starting backfill job for last 6h with concurrency 8. backfill job id: bf-20260314-09.43
carol (eng-infra): `./backfill_runner --job bf-20260314-09 --start 2026-03-14T03:20:00Z --end 2026-03-14T09:20:00Z --concurrency 8 --throttle 2000`
carol (eng-infra): starting backfill, ETA ~ 3h at current throttle; will update if faster.
bob (billing): OK. if backfill finishes by 22:30 UTC we'll proceed. can we get progress snapshots mid-run?
carol (eng-infra): yes will push periodic status to this thread every 30m and post final completion event.
eve (customer-success): prepping comms just in case. draft: "We detected an ingestion issue affecting usage reporting for a subset of customers; we are performing a backfill and expect to reconcile invoiceable usage by [time]." will sync with legal if we need to pause invoices.
alice (oncall-sre): marking incident state: Mitigated (partial) — config and restart reduced impact; running backfill to fully repair. assign owners: eng-infra (carol) for backfill, eng-ml (dave) to prepare permanent fix PR, billing (bob) for invoice decision, cs (eve) on comms.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: mitigation_action=config-change,restart,backfill; priority=P1 -> monitoring for completion.
frank (oncall-sre-2): I'll take a 30m watch and be ready to escalate if backfill stalls.
carol (eng-infra): progress update (10:12 UTC): backfill 28% complete, per-tenant deltas converging, no new warnings on aggregator-7.
carol (eng-infra): progress update (10:42 UTC): backfill 62% complete, estimated finish 12:05 UTC.
bob (billing): updated decision: hold final invoice run unless backfill completes by 21:30 UTC (billing ops timezone alignment). if not complete, billing will pause and issue interim statement to affected customers.
eve (customer-success): noted. I'll coordinate the email and CS triage list.
dave (eng-ml): opening PR draft to fix timer race, tag: @carol for review. will target safe rollout next maintenance window unless urgent hotfix requested.
alice (oncall-sre): reassigning paging followups: if backfill completes, we'll close. otherwise escalate to oncall-sre-2 and engineering leads at 18:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Final update: backfill job bf-20260314-09 completed at 12:03:18 UTC. reconciliation delta within +/-0.5% for all tenants.
carol (eng-infra): verification: sampling checks passed, invoices can proceed.
bob (billing): thanks team — proceeding with invoicing as scheduled. no need for manual hold.
eve (customer-success): sending proactive note to top affected customers summarizing issue and reconciliation.
alice (oncall-sre): closing incident. root cause: rare batching/timer race causing KV cache miss under certain timing windows — permanent fix PR in review. retrospective action items: (1) promote canary for PR #4332 with extra timing fuzz tests (2) add alert to detect aggregator-level batch drops earlier (3) test backfill performance under skewed shards.
alice (oncall-sre): final note: great cross-team response, flagged for postmortem. :tada:
